{{Quote|Do you think the secrets buried in that fortress will stay hidden forever?|[[Darth Malgus]]|<ref name="TOR:DD" />}}
The '''Temple of Nul''' was a [[Sith temple/Legends|Sith Temple]] that belonged to the ancient [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Nul]] on the<ref name="Disorder">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20220215-0|text="Disorder"|int=Disorder}}</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Mission Abstract" /> [[Elom (planet)/Legends|Elom]] that was later in ruins by the time of the [[third Galactic War]]<ref name="Ruins of Nul">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=flashpoint|Ruins of Nul}}</ref>.

==History==
{{Quote|The more we examine the powerful device at the center of these ruins, the more concerned I become. There is a dark energy that radiates from it, one that I recognize all too well. I fear how being so close to it affects Sa'har. But I must put my uneasiness aside, for now. My focus must be finding and destroying the holocron of Nul left here. All of her designs--her plans--could be within.|[[Denolm Orr]]|<ref name="TOR:DD" />}}
The temple was built as a fortress that was spread out across the planet, which contained many of Nul's creations. The most notable ones were stored in the main temple, which rested on a high peak which housed a machine protecting a [[Darth Nul's holocron|holocron]] that contained the locations of "unworthy" [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] children deemed useless by both the [[Sith Order (Sith Empire)|Sith]] and the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi]].<ref name="Disorder" />

After [[Darth Malgus]]'s theft of an artifact on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], both the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Empire]] and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] learned of the artifact's original creator: [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Nul, a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] whose records were seemingly erased from [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], which prompted both superpowers to send teams to various ruined Sith and Jedi sites including Elom which was a base used by Nul.<ref name="Secrets of the Enclave">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=flashpoint|Secrets of the Enclave}}</ref>

It was visited by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Denolm Orr]] and [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Sa'har Kateen]] to retrieve a holocron, which later resulted in Denolm's death at the hands of Darth Malgus, who took the holocron and left Sa'har to escape on her own.<ref name="Disorder" /> After Malgus escaped the temple's destruction, he came face-to-face with the [[Alliance Commander]], who defeated and imprisoned him. But Sa'har, who had also survived, found the holocron that Malgus left for her to find and escaped the planet with it.<ref name="Ruins of Nul" />
